fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the rear of the property to create a clear path for responders moving between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation that narrows or blocks access routes to the rear of the property.
• Keep a clear walking path between all access points so responders can move around the structures without obstruction.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked and unobstructed so responders can reach the back of the property without delay.
• Remove or cut back vegetation growing directly against or immediately around the detached structure so responders can approach and work around it.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items that would reduce the space available for emergency vehicles to position or turn around.
• Trim shrubs or overhanging branches along the front walkway to keep the path to the main entry clear and visible.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or touch the house and any nearby structures.
• Thin trees within the clusters closest to the structures to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of the structures.
• Separate shrubs from the nearest tree clusters so there is open ground between them.
• Clear low-hanging branches from large trees up to a height that keeps them well above any shrubs or ground vegetation below.
• Thin scattered shrubs near structures down to isolated plants with bare ground between them.
• Keep vegetation along all driveway edges trimmed back so vehicles can pass freely and without obstruction.
• Maintain open ground along all access routes so emergency vehicles can reach the structures without detours.
• Remove dead branches and dead plant material from within tree clusters near the structures.
• Keep the open terrain areas around the structures free of accumulated dry leaves, needles, and loose plant debris.
